paragraphs: The father of Elisha—Acher (“the Other”); a very wealthy man, one of Jerusalem’s leading men. See the entry Elisha.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Guggenheimer digital paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1 has Elisha speaking of Abuyah his father as one of Jerusalem’s leading men. Hyman’s heading Avuy, his “very wealthy” characterization, and his Elisha cross-reference are retained without normalizing the heading, binding the target, or importing the paragraph’s other stories, figures, or theological claims.
